::: {.home-hero} ::: {.home-hero-copy} PhD, Harvard Graduate School of Education (2022-2026) Education Policy and Program Evaluation - Email: josh [dot] b [dot] gilbert [at] gmail [dot] com ::: ::: {.home-hero-photo} ![](pictures/JG%20Headshot%202026%20AI.png){fig-alt="Portrait of Joshua Gilbert"} ::: ::: ## Current Roles - **Research Scientist**, Center for School Behavioral Health, Massachusetts General Hospital, Department of Psychiatry (2026-present) - **Adjunct Lecturer**, Harvard Graduate School of Education (2026-present) ## Education - **PhD**, Harvard Graduate School of Education (2022-2026)
Education Policy and Program Evaluation
Committee: James Kim, Luke Miratrix, Benjamin Domingue
Dissertation: *Synthesizing Psychometrics and Causal Inference: Applications of Latent Variable Models to Treatment Heterogeneity, Psychological Networks, and Learning Transfer* ([doi](https://search.proquest.com/dissertations-theses/synthesizing-psychometrics-causal-inference/docview/3351309392/se-2?accountid=11311)) Spencer Dissertation Fellow (2025-2026) - **EdM**, Harvard Graduate School of Education (2016-2017) - **BM**, New England Conservatory of Music (2012-2016) ## Work Summary My work integrates psychometrics and causal inference to improve how researchers measure outcomes and estimate intervention effects. As a Research Scientist in the Center for School Behavioral Health at Massachusetts General Hospital's Department of Psychiatry and an Adjunct Lecturer at the Harvard Graduate School of Education, I develop statistical methods for item-level analysis, treatment effect heterogeneity, and research synthesis, with applications in education, psychology, and health research. I also prioritize open and reproducible workflows through shared code and data resources. ## Selected Accomplishments - Built a publication portfolio that currently includes **37 peer-reviewed journal publications** and **19 working papers** under revision, review, or in preparation (see [Research](research.qmd)). - Received the **International Literacy Association Outstanding Article Award (2026)** ([link](https://www.literacyworldwide.org/get-involved/awards-recognition/awards-grants/outstanding-article-award-reading-research-quarterly)). - Received the **Spencer Dissertation Fellowship (2025-2026)** from the National Academy of Education. - Published methodological work in journals including *Behavior Research Methods*, *Journal of Educational and Behavioral Statistics*, *Psychological Methods*, and *Journal of Policy Analysis and Management*. - Delivered invited talks and workshops at institutions and conferences such as Stanford, Oxford, NCME, and IMPS (see [Presentations](presentations.qmd)). - Collaborated across disciplinary teams spanning education policy, psychometrics, causal inference, and ophthalmology. ## Overview This site provides a multi-page academic profile with separate sections for: - [Research](research.qmd) - [Teaching](teaching.qmd) - [Presentations](presentations.qmd) - [Service](service.qmd) ## External Links - [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=OCdG4IgAAAAJ&hl=en) - [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3496-2710) - [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/josh-b-gilbert/) - [Harvard Dataverse](https://dataverse.harvard.edu/dataverse/josh_gilbert/) - [Measured Response Substack](https://measuredresponse.substack.com)
